At line <L>, it calls _considerFilter(). _considerFilter()'s intention is The method's primary purpose is to apply a filter to a JsonParser if necessary. It checks if a filter is present and not already applied, then wraps the parser with a FilteringParserDelegate using the filter.

It initializes the parser for multi-read, advances to the next token, sets up the deserialization context, and constructs the iterator with the appropriate deserializer.
